cognitive_capacity.rationale: The single-property shape identification prompts use familiar objects and edge counts appropriate for Grade 1 learners, without imposing multi-step reasoning or excessive language.

competency_alignment.rationale: Every item asks learners to identify one of the named simple two-dimensional shapes from defining edge properties, directly matching the stated Grade 1 geometry competency.
